scenario: Paced publication waves with two production Feed fanout workers sharing MySQL
measurement_type: bounded sustained-write and post-write drain acceptance; one host

consistency_checks: all videos received exactly 320 unique inbox rows
worker attempts matched three 128-row batches plus one terminal empty batch per video
the first 50 Following Feed entries were valid fixture videos with a continuation cursor

limitations: Both API processes and MySQL/Redis ran on one WSL2 host.
The write window was about 7.3 seconds and used one author with 320 followers.
This verifies a bounded workload and drain deadline; it does not establish multi-host capacity, long-duration throughput, or behavior at larger follower counts.
